title: A Contact for the Deadline
author: H. M. Zhou
blurb: Elodie Nystrom, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
